mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, description, is_default, product, data_scope, create_time, last_modify_time FROM sys_role WHERE code = #{code} LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.is_default, r.product, r.data_scope, r.create_time, r.last_modify_time FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.code ASC
